changes.title: Creator alive
items: In the creator she can't keep still: she fixes her hat, twirls, bounces, laughs, looks out of the window, practises a step and looks round the room, and spins to show off each change you make
The fairy lights round her room come on one by one as the forest grows, and flash when it's ready

changes.title: More sounds
items: A legend roars when it turns angry
Dancing party animals tap their party shoes on the beat
Ponds lap at their edges, with a frog now and then
Picnics in the party areas murmur and clink
The creator's room in the treehouse has its own quiet sounds: a record's crackle and the timber creaking

changes.title: Fox evolution
items: The fox evolves: a fluffy kit with huge ears, a slim long-legged young, an adult with a ruff and a second little tail, and the stone shrine's legend: a kitsune with seven tails sweeping up like flames, fox-fire at their tips, a white mask and stone prayer beads round its legs
